entry.name: The ground rules, the fixtures and the hook
entry.red: Every ast-grep, dependency-cruiser and knip fixture is accepted by the tree as it stands, so `./scripts/rules.sh fixtures` names each rule as not firing: the euro sign, the em and en dash, money as a non-integer, fetch inside packages/core, a credential literal in a test, node:fs inside packages/core, a marketplace write outside the policy gate, a query outside the repository layer, an app importing another app, a cloud SDK outside packages/providers, the connectors importing the agent, the network outside the generated clients, and an unused export in packages/core.
